proposition: Nafsat I says the great Sufi masters (Tirmizī, Ghazālī, Anṣārī, Ḥamuvayī) wrote to the same effect, citing Tirmizī's questions as answered by Ḥamuvayī and Ibn ʿArabī, and concludes that Sufis aim only at Muḥammad's status and the Quran's knowledge.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to the ruler who was judging him
Melvin-Koushki, The Quest for a Universal Science (Yale 2012)
